sec_email.title: SEC contact email
sec_email.description: The SEC requires automated EDGAR clients to send a User-Agent that identifies a real, reachable mailbox. This value is sent verbatim as SEC_USER_AGENT. Use a mailbox you actually read; the setup rejects obvious placeholders and your data requests will fail without a valid address.
